    Cashier

    Cashier.DrinkOption
    A choice a customer adds to a drink: an ice level, a sweetness level or a topping
    Cashier.DrinkOption.Group
     
    Cashier.Employee
    A cashier who can be chosen to ring up orders
    Cashier.MenuItem
    A drink on the menu, as the Cashier shows and sells it
    Cashier.OrderHistory
    Shows the most recent orders with their time, cashier, payment, total and items
    Cashier.OrderLine
    One line of an order: a drink, how many, the chosen options and the price of one drink with its options
    Cashier.WidthTrackingPanel
    A panel that always fits the width of its scroll pane, so the Cashier's menu cards shrink instead of being cut off
    CheckoutDialog
    The checkout dialog: reviews the order, takes the payment method and tip, and saves the order
    CheckoutDialog.OrderService
    Saves a completed Cashier order: the order, its items and options, and the inventory it used, in one transaction
    CheckoutDialog.OrderService.OrderDetails
     
    Database
    Database access shared by both GUIs: the connection settings from .env, transactions, new ids, the latest order date, and the inventory items that are not used exactly as a recipe says.
    Database.TransactionWork
    Work that runs inside a transaction and may fail with a database error.

    Manager page for viewing, adding, editing and removing employees
    EmployeePage.NewEmployee
     
    InventoryPage
    Manager page for viewing, adding and editing inventory items and their quantities.
    InventoryPage.InventoryValues
    Stores the values entered for an inventory item.
    Manager
    Provides the manager interface for the Sharetea POS system.
    Manager.DateRangeBar
    Provides date selection controls for manager reports.
    Manager.DateRangeBar.DateRange
    Represents an inclusive date range used for database reports.
    Manager.Page
    Represents a page within the Manager interface.
    MenuPage
    Provides the menu management page for the Sharetea POS manager interface.
    MenuPage.MenuItemValues
    Stores validated menu item details entered in the add or edit form.
    OrderingTrendsPage
    Manager page with sales reports for a date range, including order count, revenue, average order value, a chart of orders over time, and sales of individual menu items, filtered by drink category.
    OrderingTrendsPage.OrdersChartPanel
    Custom panel that draws a line chart of order counts over time, with labeled axes, gridlines, and date labels spaced to avoid overlap.
    OrderingTrendsPage.XReport
    Generates today's X-report, which summarizes hourly sales activity, daily transaction totals, and sales grouped by payment method.
    OrderingTrendsPage.XReport.HourActivity
    Stores the sales and transaction counts for a single hour.
    ProductUsagePage
    Manager page showing how much of each inventory item was used in a date range, as a graph and a table.
    ProductUsagePage.UsageChartPanel
    Horizontal bar graph of inventory used, one unit at a time, largest amount first and labeled with exact amounts.
    ProductUsagePage.UsageChartPanel.Usage
    How much of one inventory item was used, in its unit.
    ReorderPage
    Manager page for restock requests: create them, and complete them when the stock arrives.
    Style
    Shared look for the Cashier and Manager GUIs: colors, sizes, fonts, button styles, message boxes, simple forms and the read-only table model
    Style.ReadOnlyTableModel
    A table model whose cells cannot be edited, used by every read-only table in the GUIs
